question: In December 2024, which foundation day was celebrated by the Border Security Force (BSF) of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**60th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Border Security Force (BSF)**, India's premier border-guarding agency, celebrated its **60th Raising Day** on **December 1, 2024**.
 
• Established on **December 1, 1965**, the force was created in the wake of the **Indo-Pakistani War of 1965** to ensure the security of India's borders and for matters connected therewith.
 
• The **60th anniversary** marks six decades of the force's dedicated service as the **"First Line of Defence"** of the Indian territories, particularly along the borders with **Pakistan** and **Bangladesh**.
 
• The BSF is one of the seven **Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF)** of India and is currently the **world's largest border-guarding force**, with a strength of approximately **2.65 lakh personnel** across **193 battalions**.
